points: Bare-metal C control firmware on STM32 for silicon photonic engines: microrings, MZI and bandpass filters, SOAs, TECs, comb lasers and photodiodes.
Architected the secure bootloader from scratch: dual application banks, encrypted images, run/commit tracking and automatic rollback.
CMIS 5.3 CDB firmware update in LPL and EPL modes as I2C state machines, plus Python host tooling.
Drivers for I2C, SPI, UART, ADC, DAC, GPIO and timers under a cooperative scheduler; ASIC silicon and board bring-up.
Closed-loop control and production calibration with per-unit coefficients stored in flash.
Profiled HMI runtime firmware on multi-core ARM SoCs (including Qualcomm) with ftrace, perf and kernel-level instrumentation, cutting touch-to-render latency by 15 ms.
Built reproducible embedded Linux images across 4 hardware platforms with containerized toolchains and BSP layers.
Brought up remote debug and display channels with Wayland/Weston and TigerVNC/TightVNC on headless boards.
Validated Modbus RTU/TCP between PLC and HMI nodes across 3 hardware revisions.
Built a Python pipeline translating XML configuration into executable CLI commands, cutting manual configuration time by 87.5%.
Designed a schema-driven unit test framework for the generated commands and sped up large-file XML validation by 25%.
Automated firmware integration testing in Python and MATLAB, cutting regression cycles from 8 hours to under 1.
Characterized Si3N4 microcantilever resonators, identifying a 430 kHz resonance and peak splitting above 400 mV actuation.
Operated an MSA-500 LDV, vacuum microprobe station, Pfeiffer turbo pumps and MFLI and SR844 lock-in amplifiers.
Findings contributed to 2 new sensor design hypotheses.
